# Concepts Model

The Concepts Model fixes the vocabulary: concepts, their attributes and their relations (`isa`, part-of, and plain relations with a label and a multiplicity).

Method: 4EM (Sandkuhl, Stirna, Persson and Wißotzki, *Enterprise Modeling: Tackling Business Challenges with the 4EM Method*, Springer 2014). Every element cites its source; `decided` means a source shows that the operator decided it.

| <a id="concept-org-ir"></a><code>concept-org-ir</code><br/>Concept | **Persistent IR.** The intermediate representation of a story: JSON owned by tsukuri, with a schema for a chosen subset of SMIL, SCXML and FRP constructs. It is a format authors and tools edit, not an artifact. Attributes: a schema for a chosen subset of SMIL, SCXML and FRP constructs; isomorphic codecs where formats round-trip. | decided |  | [log L25][1] |
| <a id="concept-org-artifact"></a><code>concept-org-artifact</code><br/>Concept | **Artifact.** A produced file or site that people consume: a video, a presentation deck, or an interactive website. Artifact formats are not IR formats. Fountain is both an importer (a screenplay becomes a story) and an artifact renderer (a story becomes a screenplay); it is not the persistent IR, which stays JSON. Attributes: static or dynamic interface; interaction surfaces. | decided |  | [log L25][1], [log L37][2], [log L67-69][3] |
| <a id="concept-org-interaction"></a><code>concept-org-interaction</code><br/>Concept | **Interaction.** An interaction is an element that can trigger events. It is surfaced to people and agents as a function, a tool call or a web control, and in a video as a scheduled event with a visible cursor. | decided |  | [log L37][2], [log L38][4], [log L39][5] |
| <a id="concept-org-tier"></a><code>concept-org-tier</code><br/>Concept | **Free and paid tier.** A free tier holds the basic features that cost nothing to run. Costly premium features, such as multiplayer collaboration and heavily integrated hosted AI agents, sit behind a paywall. Attributes: feature; run cost. | decided |  | [log L43][6] |
| <a id="concept-org-plugin"></a><code>concept-org-plugin</code><br/>Concept | **Plugin or extension.** A piece written by a user that extends the compiler or a product, such as a plugin, an extension or a render engine built with the SDK. | <a id="concept-org-agent-tool-protocol"></a><code>concept-org-agent-tool-protocol</code><br/>Concept | **Agent tool protocol.** Each tool through which an agent reads a story, applies an edit and runs the checks is declared once, in a protocol-neutral way.     concept_studio_json_patch --> concept_studio_loro_update : describes the edit of
```mermaid
    concept_studio_revision --> concept_studio_keyed_document : projected from
    concept_studio_sync_room *-- concept_studio_validation_gate
    concept_studio_repair_proposal --> concept_studio_validation_gate : offered after a refusal
    concept_studio_suggestion --> concept_studio_json_patch : applies as
    concept_studio_suggestion --> concept_studio_repair_proposal : a repair is one kind
    concept_studio_sync_room --> concept_studio_keyed_document : holds the shared copy of
    concept_studio_peer --> concept_studio_loro_update : produces
    concept_studio_lens <|-- concept_studio_deck_view
    concept_studio_deck_view *-- concept_studio_take
    concept_studio_deck_view *-- concept_studio_narration_piece
    concept_studio_anchor_offset --> concept_studio_narration_piece : an anchor can be a narration word
    concept_studio_agent_scope --> concept_studio_suggestion : suggest scope creates
```

Attributes: id; nodes; edges; viewport; attribution option. | decided |  | [log L48][77], [foldkit-flow:README.md:3][78], [foldkit-flow:README.md:24][79], [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/model.ts:14-29][80], [log L118][15] |
| <a id="concept-flow-handle"></a><code>concept-flow-handle</code><br/>Concept | **Handle.** A handle is a connection point on a node. A person drags from one handle to another to make a connection. | <a id="concept-flow-connection"></a><code>concept-flow-connection</code><br/>Concept | **Connection.** A connection is a pair of handles that a person joins with a gesture. | <a id="concept-flow-selection"></a><code>concept-flow-selection</code><br/>Concept | **Selection.** The selection is the set of nodes and edges the person has picked by click, box or key. | <a id="concept-flow-attribution"></a><code>concept-flow-attribution</code><br/>Concept | **Attribution.** Attribution is the "Built with xyflow" link in the corner of the canvas. | <a id="concept-flow-mount"></a><code>concept-flow-mount</code><br/>Concept | **Mount.** A Mount is a Foldkit construct that runs work when an element appears and cleans up when it goes. | <a id="concept-flow-controller"></a><code>concept-flow-controller</code><br/>Concept | **Controller.** A controller is an xyflow object that handles one kind of interaction: pan and zoom, node drag, handle connection or the minimap. | decided |  | [foldkit-flow:README.md:86][92], [foldkit-flow:AGENTS.md:63][95], [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/xyflow.ts:7-20][97], [log L118][15] |
| <a id="concept-flow-out-message"></a><code>concept-flow-out-message</code><br/>Concept | **Out-message (outcome).** An out-message tells the application what a gesture produced: Connected, Reconnected, Deleted, Moved or a selection change. | <a id="concept-flow-node"></a><code>concept-flow-node</code><br/>Concept | **Node.** A node is one box on the canvas. | <a id="concept-flow-edge"></a><code>concept-flow-edge</code><br/>Concept | **Edge.** An edge is a line between a source handle and a target handle. Attributes: id; source node and handle; target node and handle; kind; arrow; label. *Why proposed:* README line 47 shows an edge, and line 66 says there are three edge types with an optional arrow. types.ts lines 63 to 77 define the kinds (Bezier, SmoothStep, Straight) and the fields, including a label. | <a id="concept-flow-minimap"></a><code>concept-flow-minimap</code><br/>Concept | **Minimap and controls.** The minimap is a small overview of the graph that a person can drag to pan. The operator must confirm them as part of the first release. | proposed |  | [foldkit-flow:README.md:66][86], [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/view.ts:464-478][105], [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/view.ts:499-523][106] |
| <a id="concept-flow-live-region"></a><code>concept-flow-live-region</code><br/>Concept | **Live region.** The live region is a polite status area that announces selection, moves, connections and deletions to screen readers. *Why proposed:* README line 76 says a polite live region (`role="status"`) announces selection, moves, connections and deletions, and view.ts lines 665 to 673 render it. The operator must confirm the live region as part of the keyboard contract. | proposed |  | [foldkit-flow:README.md:76][107], [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/view.ts:665-673][108] |
